result:
These queries were written from the page alone and none has been run. A few spots rest on guesses about verbs the page does not show:

- **`round` (N2, N9):** I did not use a digits argument for `round`. I scale with `mul`, round, then scale back with `div`.
- **`sum` on an empty vector (N12):** it should answer 0 for a release with no assets, but the page does not say so.
- **No `trim` verb (N10, N14):** the page lists none. I strip stray spaces by splitting on `" "` and taking the first non-empty piece.

N1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | type | eq ::string) * (/email | split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort
N2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * {:c /customer/name :s (/lines * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum) :d (at :discount | coalesce 0)} * {:c /c :a (sub /s /d)} | groupBy ~/c * (/ * /a | sum) | entries * {:customer /0 :total (/1 | mul 100 | round | div 100)} | sort ~([(/total | desc)]) | take 2
N3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :assignee | coalesce {:login "unassigned"} | /login) | groupBy * count
N4: :p / | (at :dependencies | coalesce {}) | union (p | at :devDependencies | coalesce {}) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * /0 | sort
N5: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | {:enabledCount count :ports (vals * (at :port) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (vals * (at :replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)}
N6: lines | filter ~(contains " ERROR ") * (split " " | /2 | drop 1 | take (count | sub 1)) | groupBy * count | entries * {:service (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /service]) | take 2
N7: lines | drop 1 * (split ",") | filter ~(count | eq 4) | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | filter ~(/3 | ne "") * {:r (/0 | lower) :v (mul (/2 | parseJson) (/3 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~/r * (/ * /v | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100)
N8: :e / | (filter ~(/type | lower | eq "login") * /user | distinct) | minus (e | filter ~(/type | lower | eq "logout") * /user | distinct) | sort
N9: filter ~(at :salary | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~/dept * (/ * /salary | [sum count] | div /0 /1 | mul 10 | round | div 10)
N10: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split ":" | /1 | split ",") | flat * (split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | first | lower) | distinct | sort
N11: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","apple","date"] * lower | groupBy * count | entries | filter ~(/1 | gt 1) * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /word])
N12: /releases | filter ~(/draft | eq false) | filter ~(/prerelease | eq false) * {:tag /tag_name :downloads (/assets * (at :download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~([(/downloads | desc)]) | take 3
N13: filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | {:count count :allPriced (every ~(at :price | coalesce 0 | gt 0)) :inStockNames (filter ~(/stock | gt 0) * /name | sort)}
N14: lines * (split "#" | first) | filter ~(contains "==") * (split "==") * [(/0 | split " " | first | lower | keyword) (/1 | split " " | first)] | tag ::map
